data.title: US strikes Iran for first time in a month, Tehran retaliates
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United States said on Sunday it had attacked Iranian rocket launchers on a small island in the Strait of Hormuz, its first strikes on Iran in a month, prompting Tehran to retaliate.

data.title: 'Land & Sea' food fest ends soon
data.description: <p>Food lovers have until tomorrow to experience the ultimate gastronomic face-off during "Land &amp; Sea", which brings together renowned brands, premium ingredients and signature dishes on the same premises at Quartier Avenue, ground floor of EmQuartier, Sukhumvit Road.</p>

data.title: NCT 127 celebrates 10 years  with 'The Redline' in Bangkok
data.description: <p>NCT 127 will celebrate their 10th anniversary in Thailand with "NCT 127 5th Tour Neo City: Bangkok - The Redline" at Thammasat Stadium on Oct 31 and Nov 1.</p>

data.title: Back-to-back titles for Sarut
data.description: <p>Sarut Vongchaisit eagled the first playoff hole to defeat Peradol Panyathanasedh and secure his second consecutive title at the Singha Bangkok Open 2026 at Bangkok Golf Club in Pathum Thani yesterday.</p>

data.title: Thailand eye qualification despite tough U20 draw
data.description: <p>Thailand U20 head coach Jakkrapan Punpee believes his team could qualify for the 2027 AFC U20 Asian Championship in China despite being placed in a tough group for the qualifying competition.</p>

data.title: Poll backs 3rd phase of subsidy scheme
data.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has welcomed strong support for the government's "Thais Help Thais Plus" subsidy programme, which was named its top achievement in a Suan Dusit Poll this month.

data.title: How the 'Blue Senators' claim turned into a sprawling probe
data.description: <p>In late July, Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) Director Yingcheep Atchanont presented evidence alleging that nine Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) figures, including party leader and Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, manipulated the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Excise tax for car industry set for review
data.description: <p>The government is accelerating an overhaul of the excise tax structure to retain investment in Thailand's automotive industry, particularly as the electric vehicle market expands, government spokeswoman Rachada Dhnadirek said on Sunday.</p>

data.title: MoU to boost Ethopia ties
data.description: Thailand and Ethiopia have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) establishing a mechanism for regular political consultations and exchanges on regional and international issues of mutual interest.

data.title: Senior officers benched after club raid
data.description: <p>Five senior police officers from Huai Khwang district have been transferred to an inactive post following a raid on a suspected unlicensed entertainment venue in the area.</p>

data.title: Cops arrest American man wanted for child sex abuse
data.description: <p>Phuket: An American man wanted in the United States on eight warrants over alleged sexual offences against children was arrested at a hotel on Saturday, police said.</p>

data.title: Money and politics blamed for unrest
data.description: Residents of the three southern border provinces point to budget allocations, grey-capital interests and local politics as leading factors behind the latest wave of unrest, a Nida Poll survey found.

data.title: EC denies narrowing Senate charges to 10
data.description: <p>The Election Commission (EC) on Sunday dismissed speculation it had already decided to charge only 10 people in the Senate election collusion case.</p>

data.title: Khao swè diplomacy
data.description: <p>Northern speciality khao soi is already a familiar sight in Thailand. But in Myanmar, they also have khao sw&egrave;. How could the two noodle dishes that look and sound so similar taste so different?</p>

data.title: Aussies seek broader ties
data.description: <p>Australia is seeking a broader and more resilient partnership with Thailand, with new ambassador Pablo Kang identifying trade and supply chains, artificial intelligence, transnational crime, clean energy and Thailand's OECD ambitions as key areas for deeper cooperation.</p>

data.title: Minister calls for action to curb coastal erosion
data.description: <p>SONGKHLA: Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn has ordered state agencies to accelerate measures to curb coastal erosion in Thepha district, warning the problem could pose a risk to Highway 43, a key route to Thailand's southern border provinces.</p>

data.title: Forensics due today at Khlong Thom site
data.description: <p>More than 100 witnesses and victims have been questioned as police investigate the fire at Bangkok's Khlong Thom Center, with forensic examination of the site expected to begin at 8am on Monday.</p>

data.title: Google Maps renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America' in US -- but not Canada
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Google redesignated Lake Ontario as "Lake America" on maps seen by US users Sunday after President Donald Trump announced he was renaming the body of water, with a Canadian official slamming the cross-border tensions as "absolutely backwards."

data.title: The paradox of Anutin's govt
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's government may have little to fear from a parliamentary revolt, but its biggest political threat could be building beyond the walls of parliament: a growing public perception that corruption, political collusion and double standards are becoming entrenched under its watch.</p>

data.title: Jai's hat-trick of golds helps                         Thais top Asian track charts
data.description: <p>Jai Angsuthasawit claimed his third gold medal of the Track Asia Cup 2026 on Sunday, powering to victory in the men's individual sprint to cap a dominant showing that lifted Thailand's cycling team to three golds, one silver and two bronzes at the three-day meet in Bangkok.</p>

data.title: At least seven die in ferry capsize off Northern Cyprus; 23 missing
data.description: GIRNE KEPUVEIA (CYPRUS) - A passenger ferry capsized and sank off Northern Cyprus on Sunday, killing at least seven people and leaving 23 missing, officials said, as a rescue operation was under way.

data.title: Niger mutiny suppressed, but questions remain over junta's cohesion
data.description: ABIDJAN - Niger's military regime and its Russian paramilitary partners put down a mutiny by soldiers after a long and confusing day of fighting around the capital Niamey.

data.title: Zambia's opposition leader charged with treason
data.description: LUSAKA - Zambia's detained opposition leader Brian Mundubile has been charged with treason, his lawyer said on Sunday, deepening concerns over the government's treatment of political dissent.

data.title: Fernandes treble inspires Man Utd rout, Chelsea beat Brighton in thriller
data.description: LONDON - Bruno Fernandes starred with a hat-trick in Manchester United's 5-2 rout of Ipswich, while Chelsea extended Xabi Alonso's perfect start with a thrilling 4-3 win against Brighton on Sunday.
